title: Sculptor in Chains
description: A female sculptor with long dark hair in a ponytail stands dynamically on one leg atop a black table in an artist's studio. She wears a black crop top and blue shorts, holds a chain connected to a hanging hook with one hand while her other leg is raised, with a detailed male bust sculpture and tools visible on the adjacent table against a large backdrop of blue figure sketches.
prompt: A highly detailed realistic scene of a female sculptor with long flowing dark hair in a high ponytail, wearing a black sports bra and short blue denim shorts, standing dynamically on one bare foot on a black work table while her other leg is raised high behind her. She holds a metal chain with one hand that hangs from the ceiling, her body in a tense artistic pose. Next to her on another table is a realistic male bust sculpture on a black base. The background features a large torn paper backdrop covered in blue figure sketches and anatomical studies, with art tools, papers, and a small sign scattered around the studio, dramatic lighting, photorealistic, intricate details
